NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
2142 West 18" Place
From RT-4 to RM-5
hs
The subject property is situated in a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District on the south side
of West 18th Place. It is located in a Transit Served Location approximately 990.0’ from the CTA Damen Pink Line
Station Entrance. :

The property is one zoning lot comprised of two parcels (Lot 31 and Lot 32). Lot 31 is a vacant lot. Lot 32 is improved
with a two story residential building (approx. 27.0’ height) with five dwelling units and no parking.

The Project :

Coach House Properties LLC (the “Applicant”) seeks to rezone the property to split Lot 31 and 32 into two individual
zoning lots to allow Lot 32 to be rezoned so the Applicant may legalize the existing building’s bulk, existing five
dwelling unit density, and legalize setbacks, and reduce rear yard open space. The building will remain and the building
height will remain. There is no parking and none will be provided.

Lot 31 will remain under the RT-4 zoning district and will be developed into a three story residential building (approx.
27-11” height) and will include three dwelling units and three parking spaces.

The Applicant seeks to rezone the property from an RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to
an RM-5, Residential Multi-Unit District.

As part of the rezoning application, the Applicant also seeks all relief as needed for Lot 32, as allowed by the Chicago
Zoning Code, through a Type-1 application under section 17-13-0300(D) and also including: 1) an optional variation
under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the front yard setback per section 17-2-0305 from 15.0’ to 3'-1 1/2” (existing);
2) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the west side setback per section 17-2-0309 from 2.0' to
47/8" (existing); 3) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the combined side yard setback per
section 17-2-0309 from 4.8’ to 3-3 1/8" (existing); 4) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the
rear yard setback per section 17-2-0306 from 37.236’ to 14'-1 1/4" (existing).

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 2,978.88 square feet

FAR: 1.58 (existing)

Floor Area: 4,694 square feet (existing)

Residential Dwelling Units: 5 (existing)

MLA Density: 1,600 square feet (existing)

Height: 27.0’ (existing)
